note: Effort is a rough estimate in working weeks of remaining work. Status: done | in-progress | built-local | planned | idea. Edit this file; the site reads it.

items.title: Storage and sync v10
items.notes: Version 1 built on desktop and merging in PR #13. Remaining: Android transport, hardening (binding token, clone and fork detection), restore from folder, retire device, out-of-date warning, backup hardening, iOS.

items.title: Governance and docs
items.notes: Governance doc, ADR and spec templates, roadmap site, one feature spec per item in docs/features. Milestones added. Remaining: CI crowd typecheck, branch clean-up.

items.title: Shared cloud hosting decision
items.notes: One stack for static Shamela books and the crowd ranking service (for example R2 plus a Worker). Write the ADR first. Cloud shape is in specs/data-architecture.md section 5.

items.title: Host Shamela books on cloud
items.notes: scripts/shamela-host (upload.mjs, cors.json) exists, untracked. Licence of each source must be recorded.

items.title: Crowd data: sense ranking and vocabulary statistics
items.notes: Built and tested (client, server, Alt+P), merging in PR #13. Not deployed. Remaining: deployment, privacy page, optional marker, local statistics.

items.title: Poetry encyclopedia edition
items.notes: Parked. The poetry-web app (separate folder, own session) is the working version of this idea and may come in later as a plug-in. No feature spec until then.

items.title: Standalone popup and tokenizer module
items.notes: Make word lookup work on any text, not only the book reader. Unlocks extension, video and audiobooks. Audit coupling in DictionaryPopup first.

items.title: Web extension
items.notes: Tap-to-define on any web page, saves into the same vocabulary.

items.title: Video support
items.notes: Subtitle tracks as tappable text.

items.title: Audiobooks
items.notes: Text-synced audio: highlight while playing. Audio hosting needs the cloud stack and licences.

items.title: Plug-in API (Kindle-like and KOReader-style)
items.notes: Design only after two or three internal features show what extension points are needed. Needs its own ADR on permissions and review.

items.title: Hashiya mode: editable canvas for annotation
items.notes: Miro-like environment over the text. Largest unknown; a good first real plug-in.

items.title: Community layer and website
items.notes: Start as a GitHub-hosted registry of plug-ins and shared glossaries; a real site only when people want to publish or discuss.

items.title: Alt+N note and Alt+F flashcard
items.notes: Floating cards that do not block the reader. Latest commit on the sync branch (v0.29.0).

items.title: + icon: single-entry lookup in the reader
items.notes: A + control that returns one chosen entry for the tapped word. src/popupAddDictionary and saveLookup already exist: audit what is covered first.

items.title: Click then Space saves a vocab card
items.notes: Shortcut to save the tapped word without opening the card. src/readerChords exists, so this is probably a new chord.

items.title: Full-page dictionary with dictionary switching
items.notes: Maximise the popup into a full page like a normal book dictionary, switch between dictionaries, and search it as a plain dictionary from the reader. src/dictionarySearch exists: audit.

items.title: Import TXT, Markdown and MOBI/AZW3
items.notes: Convert to the internal book model on import. TXT first (half a week), then MOBI/AZW3. Also the formats the watched folder can pick up.

items.title: Import PDF
items.notes: Hardest format: reflowing text, RTL order and diacritics. Scanned PDFs need OCR (separate idea).

items.title: Anki integration end to end
items.notes: Basic AnkiConnect sync exists (src/anki). Audit gaps: note types, media, two-way review state, deck mapping, no-Anki-running fallback (.apkg export).

items.title: Export hub: Quizlet, Notion, CSV
items.notes: One export model with several writers, built on the Anki audit.

items.title: Sentence mining and cloze cards
items.notes: Suggested. Save the surrounding sentence with the card and offer cloze cards. Feeds Anki and the export hub.

items.title: Pronunciation audio (offline TTS)
items.notes: Suggested. Speak a word or sentence; attach audio to cards. Needs a licence check on voices.

items.title: Book difficulty and pre-reading word list
items.notes: Suggested. Estimate difficulty from word frequency and your known vocabulary; list words to learn before a chapter. Overlaps the crowd spec, so reuse its data. Crowd data is optional (a second ordering signal), not a prerequisite.

items.title: Import Kindle highlights and vocab
items.notes: Suggested. Read My Clippings.txt and Kindle vocab.db into vocabulary and highlights.

items.title: Camera and scanned-page lookup (OCR)
items.notes: Suggested. Point at a printed page or scanned PDF and tap words. Mobile first.

items.title: Root and morphology explorer
items.notes: Suggested. Browse a root family and verb forms from any entry. Verb-form data is already parked in memory.

items.title: Watched folder: automatic book import
items.notes: Point the app at a folder; new books are imported automatically, duplicates skipped by content hash. Desktop (Electron) can watch continuously by reusing the folder bridge built for sync; mobile can only scan on open (Android folder access, iOS security-scoped bookmark). EPUB first; other formats arrive with the format work. Decide: copy into the library or reference in place, and what happens when the file is deleted from the folder. Needs a spec (file access and duplicate handling).

items.title: Scan device for books, with in-app filter
items.notes: One-tap scan that finds every EPUB and PDF (later MOBI/TXT) and lists them in a "Found on this device" view, with filters by format, folder, size, date and already-imported, and a multi-select import. The user chooses which to import; nothing is imported silently. Platform limits: desktop can walk chosen drives or folders; Android needs MediaStore or all-files access (store policy review); iOS cannot scan the whole device, only user-picked folders. Needs a spec covering permissions and what is read (paths and metadata only until a file is chosen). Builds on the watched-folder scanner.

items.title: Data architecture spec and ADRs
items.notes: Four data classes, BlobStore, PackManager, SyncTransport, cloud shape. Draft written; needs your review and the infrastructure ADR.

items.title: BlobStore: content-addressed file storage
items.notes: One byte store for books, PDFs, audio and packs with web, Electron and mobile backends. Migrate existing book files; de-duplicates by hash. Test OPFS versus IndexedDB on iOS first.

items.title: PackManager: versioned data packs
items.notes: Signed manifest, resumable download, hash verification, eviction, offline from cache. Proof: move one dictionary onto it.

items.title: Dexie Cloud sync transport
items.notes: Second SyncTransport, same batch format and merge engine. Spec section 6 of storage-and-sync.md. Needs the account question settled (ADR).

items.title: Storage usage screen and full export
items.notes: Usage by class, per-class cleanup, export all your data in open formats.

items.title: Poetry encyclopedia web app (local only)
items.notes: Local-only Node and SQLite backend built from the user's own disc (ADR 0004). Backend first; web UI, library reader and recordings to follow. Licensed content is never committed. Parked here at the maintainer's request: developed in its own folder; may be integrated later as a plug-in. No feature spec in docs/features.

milestones.title: Consolidate
milestones.goal: One healthy main branch: integration and docs merged, sync finished for Android and hardened, the data architecture agreed, duplicate branches cleaned up, CI on every PR, sanitised iOS scripting checked on an iPhone.

milestones.title: Core reader v1.0
milestones.goal: The reading, lookup and review loop is complete and dependable: quicker saving, a full-page dictionary, sentences and cloze review, Anki end to end, more book formats, and storage you can see and export. Ready for a public 1.0.

milestones.title: Expansion
milestones.goal: Beyond books and beyond the device: hosted Shamela and data packs, shared meanings, the standalone lookup module and the surfaces built on it (web extension, video, audiobooks, camera), plus import and study tools.

milestones.title: Later
milestones.goal: Unscheduled. Platform bets that wait for users who ask for them: plug-ins, Hashiya, community, poetry.
